D\'Genius Solutions

AI Motion Graphic Designer

Seeking a creative and detail-oriented AI Motion Graphic Designer with 2-5 years of experience, specializing in AI tools, motion graphics, and luxury brand aesthetics. This role focuses on crafting premium jewellery visuals, AI-generated campaign creatives, motion graphic videos, and digital content for a high-end brand, ensuring meticulous attention to detail and brand consistency.

Section A — Multiple Choice

15 marks
1Which of these AI tools is primarily known for its advanced capabilities in generating video from text or images?
A. Midjourney
B. RunwayML
C. Adobe Photoshop
D. Leonardo AI
2In Adobe After Effects, what is the primary function of a 'pre-composition'?
A. To export a final video file.
B. To group layers and nest them into a single, editable composition.
C. To apply a single effect to multiple individual layers.
D. To convert a raster image into a vector graphic.
3When designing for a luxury jewellery brand, which typography characteristic is generally preferred?
A. Bold, condensed, and highly decorative fonts.
B. Handwritten, informal, and playful fonts.
C. Clean, elegant, often sans-serif or classic serif fonts with generous leading and kerning.
D. Distorted, pixelated, or grunge-style fonts.
4What is the main advantage of using Adobe Illustrator over Photoshop for creating a brand logo?
A. Illustrator offers more advanced photo manipulation features.
B. Illustrator creates vector graphics that are infinitely scalable without loss of quality.
C. Illustrator is better for complex video editing tasks.
D. Illustrator has a simpler interface for beginners.
5To achieve a realistic 'sparkle effect' on a diamond in a motion graphic, which technique is most commonly used?
A. Applying a simple blur filter.
B. Using a particle generator or lens flare effects, often combined with masks and keyframes.
C. Reducing the overall brightness of the diamond.
D. Converting the diamond to a monochrome color.
6When using AI to generate 'jewellery-on-model' creatives, what is a crucial step to ensure the jewellery appears naturally integrated?
A. Ensuring the model is smiling broadly.
B. Ignoring the model's existing lighting and adding new, artificial light to the jewellery.
C. Carefully matching the light source, shadows, and color temperature of the jewellery to the model's environment.
D. Using only black and white images for the model.
7Which of these is NOT a common characteristic of premium jewellery photography/videography?
A. Sharp focus on intricate details and facets.
B. Soft, diffused lighting that enhances shine without harsh reflections.
C. Busy backgrounds that distract from the product.
D. Accurate representation of metal and gemstone colors.
8What is the primary purpose of 'color grading' in video editing for a luxury brand?
A. To make the video black and white.
B. To correct technical camera errors only.
C. To establish a consistent mood, aesthetic, and brand identity across all visuals.
D. To add distracting visual effects.
9Which AI tool is known for its user-friendly interface and ability to generate diverse images from text prompts, similar to Midjourney?
A. Adobe Premiere Pro
B. Leonardo AI
C. CapCut
D. Figma
10When creating a social media reel, what aspect ratio is most commonly used and optimized for vertical viewing?
A. 16:9 (widescreen)
B. 4:3 (standard TV)
C. 1:1 (square)
D. 9:16 (vertical)
11What is 'kerning' in typography?
A. The space between lines of text.
B. The overall spacing between all characters in a block of text.
C. The adjustment of space between individual letter pairs to improve visual appeal.
D. The size of the font.
12Which Adobe tool would you primarily use for advanced photo retouching and compositing of static jewellery images?
A. Adobe Illustrator
B. Adobe After Effects
C. Adobe Photoshop
D. Adobe Premiere Pro
13What is a key consideration when designing digital ads for a premium jewellery brand to avoid looking cheap?
A. Using bright, neon colors and flashing animations.
B. Overcrowding the ad with multiple products and excessive text.
C. Employing a clean layout, high-quality imagery, and a sophisticated call-to-action.
D. Using low-resolution images to save on loading time.
14Which of these AI tools is specifically mentioned for its capability in generating images from text prompts, often used for initial concept art?
A. Adobe Premiere Pro
B. Pika Labs
C. Midjourney
D. CapCut
15When creating motion graphics for a luxury product launch, what kind of transitions would be most appropriate?
A. Abrupt cuts and jarring wipes.
B. Fast, energetic, and bouncy transitions.
C. Smooth, elegant fades, subtle pushes, or sophisticated reveals.
D. Random, chaotic transitions with glitch effects.
